title: Corpus-based Comparative Analysis of Large Language Model and Human Translation: A Case Study of the Chinese Version of The Old Man and the Sea

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3.1.3: "According to official claims, [Qwen's] performance in Chinese-language contexts has comprehensively surpassed that of GPT-4-Turbo, establishing it as one of the world's leading large language models for Chinese."

notes: GPT-4-Turbo appears only as background context comparing Qwen's marketed Chinese-language performance; the paper's actual translation-comparison subject is Qwen against a human translation, not GPT-4-Turbo.
